evidence_quote: we aimed to investigate the potential pro-inflammatory effects of sterile fecal microbiome filtrate (FMF) using a microphysiological, immunocompetent intestine-on-chip (IoC) model.
rationale: The study investigates microbiome-derived inflammation and intestinal barrier damage in ulcerative colitis. The abstract does not address cancer biology, tumor progression, tumor biomarkers, or cancer treatments.
